digest.component_or_area: plan review signing and manifest encoding
propositions: Plan review signatures must emit deterministic pins for every direct child and prerequisite relationship, encoding canonical ticket IDs, pin roles (child/prerequisite), and exact material fingerprints in the manifest before dependency lines.
Duplicate graph edges within each role must collapse; tickets appearing in both child and prerequisite roles receive exactly one pin per role, sorted lexicographically by role then canonical ID.

PlanRelationSnapshot must preload all ticket states store-wide including archived entries, discover outbound depends_on and inbound blocks without active-source filtering, canonicalize all references, and emit related_material as the deterministic pin carrier before any LLM evaluation.

Unreadable or unresolvable targets must raise PlanRelationSnapshotError with exact reason enum (missing-target, ambiguous-reference, malformed-reference, reducer-error, canonical-id-mismatch, or store-read-failure), log a structured ERROR record, and return unsigned INDETERMINATE remediation without executing LLM calls or partial pins.

tracker_head_sha() must verify a clean tickets tracker via git status --porcelain and git ls-files -u, then return the 40-hex HEAD SHA from rev-parse, mapping all git, IO, path, and output failures to store-read-failure.

Every plan-review signing path (sign_plan_review, refresh_attestation, resign_plan_review) must call collect_plan_relation_snapshot(), pass related_material to build_manifest, and preserve current manifest bytes when pins are absent; deleted targets block refresh and re-sign until relationship repair.
